blogs.title: Why Your LLM Training Collapses: The Hidden Flaw in Token-Level Reinforcement Learning
blogs.description: Explore the critical discovery behind Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO): why traditional algorithms like GRPO fail on large models due to noisy token-level importance weights. This post breaks down the math simply, explaining how accumulating errors in long sequences lead to catastrophic model collapse and why shifting the focus to the 'sequence level' is the key to stability.

blogs.title: Supercharging MoE Models: How GSPO Eliminates the Need for Complex Workarounds
blogs.description: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are powerful but notoriously difficult to train with Reinforcement Learning due to 'expert-activation volatility.' Learn how GSPO naturally solves this problem without needing expensive strategies like 'Routing Replay.' We'll discuss how GSPO's sequence-level approach allows MoE models to reach their full potential, a breakthrough that powered the latest Qwen3 improvements.

blogs.title: Less Computation, Better Results: The Counter-Intuitive Efficiency of GSPO
blogs.description: In a twist that defies conventional wisdom, GSPO clips (ignores) significantly more data tokens than previous methods yet trains faster and performs better. This article dives into the experiments showing how discarding noisy, unreliable token-level signals in favor of robust sequence-level signals leads to superior training efficiency and paves the way for simpler, cheaper RL infrastructure.
